name: PayPal
description: Lets the agent invoice customers, take payments and issue refunds through the PayPal sandbox, behind approvals and spend limits.

permissions.reason: Call the PayPal REST API. Scoped to the sandbox host, so this plugin cannot reach live PayPal.
Sign in to PayPal with your sandbox app's client ID and secret (developer.paypal.com → Apps & Credentials → Sandbox).

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.title: Create invoice (draft)
tools.description: Create a DRAFT PayPal invoice for a customer. Nothing is sent or charged until send_invoice. Amounts are decimal strings or numbers in the given currency.

due_in_days.description: Payment due date, in days from today.

tools.name: send_invoice
tools.title: Send invoice
tools.description: Send a draft invoice to the customer by email. This is a real payment request, so the user confirms it.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List recent invoices with their status and totals.

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice's status, amounts, recipient and payment link.

tools.name: cancel_sent_invoice
tools.title: Cancel sent invoice
tools.description: Cancel an invoice that was already sent, and notify the customer.

tools.name: create_order
tools.title: Create order (checkout link)
tools.description: Create a PayPal checkout order and return the link the buyer opens to approve the payment. No money moves until pay_order.

tools.name: get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Get an order's status (CREATED, APPROVED, COMPLETED...) and capture IDs.

tools.name: pay_order
tools.title: Capture payment
tools.description: Capture the payment for an order the buyer has approved. Moves money, so the user confirms it.

tools.name: create_refund
tools.title: Refund payment
tools.description: Refund a captured payment, fully or partially (pass amount for a partial refund). Sends money back, so the user confirms it.

amount.description: Omit to refund the full capture.

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: List account transactions for the last N days (max 31). Sandbox transactions can take up to a few hours to appear here.

commands.name: status
commands.title: Check the PayPal sandbox connection and limits

commands.name: clear
commands.title: Clear the PayPal activity log (limits keep counting today's total)

panels.title: PayPal
panels.description: Sandbox payments made by the agent today, against your limits.

baseUrl.description: PayPal REST base URL. The net.http grant only allows the sandbox host.

maxAmountPerAction.description: Largest amount one invoice, order or refund may carry. Larger requests are refused before PayPal is called.

dailyLimit.description: Total value the agent may invoice, charge or refund per day (UTC). Counted across all currencies at face value.
